structured.approach: I followed the DE-03 procedure in the data-engineering-steps skill. It reads feat.tasks and feat.design and writes task.db_changes. I read both inputs to find what storage the design puts in scope and which files the Data Engineering tasks (TSK-01 and TSK-02) may change. I checked this against the repository in two ways: the tool view, and my own file listing and search of ap_pipeline for database client code, DDL and migration patterns. Both showed no database. The output records an empty change register, explains why rollback and migration items do not apply, sends the logical paid_date change to DE-05 and carries the design's DQ-1 as a non-blocking question. No connector was needed, and I did not use any production data.

claims.text: The feature design lists storage, database and schema migration as out of scope; the data change is one new record key paid_date, one new reject reason 'paid_date' and in-memory structures.
DD-1 rules out any new repository, service, runtime, library or storage, and NF-10 makes every new function pure and in-memory with no I/O.
Adding storage or a network call from the libraries would reopen DES-01, and the design triggers none of these.

The Data Engineering tasks are TSK-01 (transform.py, __init__.py version step, tests/test_pipeline.py) and TSK-02 (new delays.py, new tests/test_delays.py); neither lists a DDL file, migration or table.
TSK-01 must not change ingest.py, dq.py, pipeline.py or schedule.json.
ap_pipeline has no database; no migrations exist or are required.

The ap_pipeline repository contains no migrations folder, .sql file or database client code; a search for sqlite, sqlalchemy, psycopg, CREATE TABLE, INSERT INTO, migration and connect( found no matches.
data/sample_feed.csv is a sample CSV feed file, not a database.
The invoice record (DC-1) is a plain Python dict with paid_date added as a key; this logical change belongs to DE-05 data model changes, not to a physical database change.
No input names the production component that wires the stages and carries CT-1 (DQ-1).
The shared decisions and lessons (D-2026-031, D-2026-044, D-2026-050, L-007, L-011) do not require storage.

open_questions: DBQ-1 (non-blocking, carried from feat.design DQ-1): if the production host that wires the stages later stores records, overdue rows or risk levels, a database change would be needed then. None is needed in this feature. Owner: Architect.
structured.summary: DE-03 is complete with nothing to apply. FEAT-ZD-48600 needs no database change. The design puts storage, databases and schema migrations out of scope and keeps every new function in memory. The Data Engineering tasks TSK-01 and TSK-02 change only Python modules and tests, and ap_pipeline has no database or migrations. task.db_changes records an empty change register and sends the logical paid_date record change to DE-05. There are no blocking questions.
